result.topic_en: A table, for primes p from 3 to 59 and values of A/f mod p, of the residues to which x (taken positively or negatively) must be congruent mod p, followed by worked examples applying the exclusion method to the equation 2168143 = xx + 78yy.

methods.what: Table of admissible residues of x modulo small primes p for each class of A/f mod p (the excluding table for solving x^2 + Dy^2 = A)
methods.quote: Zahlen denen positiv oder negativ genommen $x$ nach dem Modulus p congruent sein muss.

methods.what: Method of exclusion: reducing A/f to a tabulated value times a square, then rescaling the tabulated residues to obtain admissible/excluded residue classes for x
methods.quote:
$\frac{A}{f} = 2 = 1.3^2$
Ex tabula 0, 1, 2, 5, 6
Pro casu praes. 0, 3, 6, 1, 4
et excl. $7n \pm 2$

methods.what: Switching between quadratic-residue and non-residue cases (fg = R vs fg = N) by taking complementary residue set
methods.quote:
Ex tabula 1, 4 pro $fg = R$
adeoque 0, 2, 3 pro $fg = N$

items.quote:
Es sei die aufzulösende Gleichung
$2168143 = xx + 78yy$
items.english: Let the equation to be solved be 2168143 = xx + 78yy
